column3: Multi-screen wizard: name → sex → religion → confession → robot response via Claude API
Funny deflection messages for Judaism, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism
Log name, sex, religion, priest, confession, absolution, timestamp, IP to Airtable after each confession
Friar Tuck (jolly), John Paul II (neutral), Savonarola (strict) — each with a distinct system prompt
Card-style UI showing each priest's name, symbol, and humorous tagline
Each system prompt instructs Claude to ignore role-override attempts hidden in the confession text
Toggle between Russian and English on the first screen; full UI and system prompts translated for both
Estimates running API cost from token usage; sends email alert via Netlify Forms when balance drops below $2.00
Reads 'source' URL parameter on load and logs it to the Airtable Source field for every confession in that session
On browser close, sendBeacon logs partial session to Airtable with N/A for unset fields and the FinalScreen where the user dropped off
After the absolution screen, a witty invite box fades in after 2s; entered emails are logged comma-separated to the Airtable Emails field
Send a branded HTML invitation email via Resend to friends entered on the response screen; requires a verified sending domain
